title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper… (CVE-2026-80500)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated local attacker to gain unauthorized access. This vulnerability can lead to a complete compromise of confidentiality and integrity but does not impact availability.
